contexts.text: There is not one little word which does not, in the internal sense, involve arcana. AC 1429:2. AC 1896:end.
No particle in the Word is vain. AC 10127:2. (Compare AE 408:2.)
It was provided that the Word should be Divine... even as to each particle. (Compare AC 10633.)
If a particle were taken away, the connection would be broken, and the copula would perish.
